9:123.text: O you who have believed, fight against those adjacent to you of the disbelievers and let them find in you harshness. And know that Allāh is with the righteous.

9:124.text: And whenever a sūrah is revealed, there are among them
those who say, "Which of you has this increased in faith?" As for those who believed, it has increased them in faith, while they are rejoicing.

9:125.text: But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it has
And they will have died while they are disbelievers.

9:126.text: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice but then they do not repent nor do they remember?

9:127.text: And whenever a sūrah is revealed, they look at each other,
, "Does anyone see you?" and then they dismiss themselves. Allāh has dismissed their hearts because they are a people who do not understand.

9:128.text: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer;
and to the believers is kind and merciful.

9:129.text: , say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne."
